message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each except one 0) and two of each action card: Skip, Reverse, Draw Two. Plus 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card over to start the discard pile. | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the **color**, **number**, or **symbol** of the top discard. 3. If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **Custom Rules** – e.g., “Draw Two” can be played on any card, not just matching color/number.
• **House Rules** – e.g., “No Wild Draw Four on the first turn.” | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Setup** – Shuffle, deal 7 cards each, start discard pile. 2. **Turn** – Play a matching card or draw. 3. **Action** – Follow the effect of Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, or Wild Draw Four. 4. **UNO** – Say “UNO” when you’re down to one card. 5. **Finish** – First to discard all cards wins the round and scores. 6. **Repeat** – Keep playing rounds until someone hits the target score. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
